newsitem.title: USA: Oakland, Calif port says spent $43 mln on contracts.
newsitem.headline: Oakland, Calif port says spent $43 mln on contracts.

text.p: Port of Oakland in northern California said Tuesday it spent nearly $43 million in the fiscal year that ended on June 30 on public works, equipment and other types of contracts.

The Port spent more than $8.9 million on public works contracts, $6.2 million on Federal Aviation Administration contracts, purchased $15.3 million worth of materials and equipment and awarded $12.5 million in contracts.
The Port said that 26 percent of the $43 million total was earned by minority and woman-owned businesses, meeting or surpassing the Port's small business goals.
Port-area businesses directly employ more than 17,000 San Francisco Bay Area workers and pay out more than $1 billion in wages in salaries and $45 million in state and local taxes, the Port said.
